native_audit.scope:
Read-only diagnostics of recorded solver evidence; never a training verdict.

Native velocity, drive and TCP fields are snapshots at the recording frequency.
They do not recover internal integration-step extrema or identify real hardware.
No model is loaded, no RGB is decoded, and no source attributes are modified.

left.force_sample_note: Initial observation plus post-step snapshots; all-observation peaks also include pre-action feedforward updates.

right.force_sample_note: Initial observation plus post-step snapshots; all-observation peaks also include pre-action feedforward updates.

limitations: Snapshots at the recording frequency cannot bound internal substep peaks.
Native instantaneous velocity and position-difference interval velocity are different measurements.
Forces are simulation generalized forces, not measured hardware torque or identified limits.
Combined drive excludes passive and constraint forces; its two finger channels must not be mistaken for one actuator.
This diagnostic does not audit images, task success, contact realism, or training acceptance.

controller_intervals.peak_time_resolution: Control interval containing the peak; exact substep time was not recorded.
controller_intervals.scope: Recorded native substep summary consistency, not full-trace recomputation, contact validation, hardware calibration or training acceptance.

native_audit.cartesian_speed_note: Declared planning speed is not a global TCP acceptance limit. This report compares measurements without inventing a hardware or production-policy limit.

native_audit.cartesian_speed_note: Declared planning speed is not a global TCP acceptance limit. This report compares measurements without inventing a hardware or production-policy limit.

limitations: One development seed; no distribution-wide or hardware validity claim.
Observer matches the original full native snapshots and trajectory, not merely task success.
Candidate has different closed-loop actions, durations and contact timing; it is not row-aligned replay.
Quantiles are over control-interval maxima, not all 960 Hz samples.
Native interval summaries are consistency-checked; full substep traces are not independently recomputed.
State-only runs are not training-ready RGB demonstrations.
No physical threshold, actuator gain, object state or source recording is changed by this analysis.
